novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new measurement-and-control combination: it proposes a per-instance “serial-computation demand” defined by when “the internal answer stabilizes,” then allocates “just enough contentless compute-buffer tokens,” rather than newly discovering that filler tokens can supply computation. Searches using “meaningless filler tokens chain-of-thought adaptive number,” “pause tokens per-instance compute budget hidden-state logit stabilization,” and “adaptive test-time compute token allocation” identify Pfau et al., “Let’s Think Dot by Dot” (2024), Goyal et al.’s pause-token work, and AdaCoT (2025) as the closest precedents: they respectively establish content-independent filler computation, extra pause positions, and per-query reasoning allocation, but do not combine answer-representation convergence with adaptive filler-token budgeting. The step is therefore a substantive multi-step integration and new operationalization, but a natural extension of these established directions rather than a new core computational principle.
